hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(cpp|c|h|hpp)$'; then clang-format -i $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null || true; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then NEW_TODOS=$(git diff --cached -U0 | grep -E '^\+.*TODO ARM64' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$NEW_TODOS" -gt 0 ]; then echo "warning: $NEW_TODOS new 'TODO ARM64' marker(s) staged — consider resolving before committing." >&2; fi; fi; exit 0
